requirements: Add an expense with payer, amount, participants and description.
Persist data in a JSON file between runs.
Compute a minimal set of payments that settles all debts.
Handle invalid input by raising a clear exception, never crashing.
Command‑line interface supports adding people, adding expenses, and showing settlements.
Data is never lost; file is written atomically.
All library modules are pure and produce no console output.

modules.name: common
modules.purpose: Defines shared exception and simple validation helpers.
api: def validate_amount(amount: float) -> None  # raises ExpenseError if amount <= 0

modules.name: storage
modules.purpose: Load and save the ledger JSON file.
api: def load_ledger(path: str) -> dict  # returns Ledger, raises ExpenseError on I/O or malformed JSON
def save_ledger(path: str, ledger: dict) -> None  # writes Ledger atomically, raises ExpenseError on failure

modules.name: people
modules.purpose: Manage the list of participants in the ledger.
api: def add_person(ledger: dict, name: str) -> None  # adds name to ledger['people'], raises ExpenseError on duplicate or empty
def list_people(ledger: dict) -> List[str]  # returns a sorted copy of ledger['people']

modules.name: expenses
api: def add_expense(ledger: dict, payer: str, amount: float, participants: List[str], description: str) -> None  # validates and appends an Expense, raises ExpenseError on errors
def list_expenses(ledger: dict) -> List[dict]  # returns a shallow copy of ledger['expenses']

modules.name: settlement
modules.purpose: Calculate the minimal payment plan to settle all debts.
api: def compute_settlements(ledger: dict) -> List[dict]  # returns a list of Payments, raises ExpenseError if settlement impossible

modules.name: app
modules.purpose: Command‑line interface, argument parsing and user interaction.
api: def main(argv: List[str] | None = None) -> None  # parses commands, uses other modules, prints results, handles ExpenseError
